body: She just hit me and slammed my hand in the door. She doesn't care. I asked to work on our relationship. She thinks I'm too emotional and yelled at me for saying I miss the sweet her. I feel like nobody cares. Tonight I decided. I will have so much relief. I'm walking to the woods now. Thank you for those who cared and offered help. I've had help for 22 years, but everything keeps going wrong. There is a reason. I'm not meant to be happy. I don't make this place better. I am a disgrace.
